title: Database Isolation Levels
resolved_source_points: The transcript's repeated 'select start' wording was resolved from the terminal video as SELECT *.
The demonstrations use MySQL with autocommit disabled and the InnoDB behaviors described in current MySQL documentation; the concepts are portable but exact traces are not.
The serializable demonstration is a conflicting exclusive-write/shared-read lock wait on one row, not a claim that every transaction or every read blocks every other read.
The final recommendation to reproduce the one-table, one-row experiment in the learner's chosen database is treated as one instructor-assigned experiment.

tasks.purpose: Use one table, one row, and concurrent sessions to change isolation levels, predict repeated-read visibility, and explain the observed database-specific behavior.
